extracted.name: Creamy Chipotle Sauce
extracted.description: This easy chipotle sauce is a great condiment to keep on hand! Use it to spice up dishes like tacos, sandwiches, and burrito bowls. It's a delicious dipping sauce too. Find a vegan variation in the notes below.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup whole milk Greek yogurt
¼ cup mayonnaise (Sir Kensington’s is best here)
1 chipotle pepper from a can of chipotles in adobo sauce
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
instruction_lines: In a food processor, place the yogurt, mayo, chipotle pepper, garlic, lime juice, olive oil, and honey. Add a generous pinch of salt and several grinds of pepper and blend until smooth. Season to taste with more salt and pepper.
